status: exploratory feasibility, not a publication benchmark
task: RGB midpoint interpolation from two observed anchors
normalization: existing backend letterbox 320x180, retain every second decoded source frame at nominal 12fps
quantization: ONNX Runtime Conv-only; static QDQ S8/S8 per-channel MinMax; trunk includes /convblock/ Conv nodes only; transpose convolutions and warp/flow arithmetic remain float
exclusions: No training, distillation, pruning, architecture search or test-driven model selection
No claim that checkpoint training excludes these scenes
No claim that these dependent triplets establish statistical generalization
No GPU/NPU comparisons from unmatched published timings
predeclared_success_gate: A candidate must be executable on CPU, reduce median inference time by at least 20%, and lose at most 0.2 dB in equal-weight per-triplet mean PSNR versus rife49-fp32 on each of the two evaluation scenes. This is only a pilot continuation criterion, not a paper acceptance claim.
